_: Team radio lines: id -> [who, text]. who: e = race engineer, d = driver (the player). Numbered ids are from HRC_complete_team_radio_library_350.txt (only the lines whose event exists in the game); the others are extra lines the library doesn't cover. {placeholders} are filled in by the game and get no voice file. tools/radio-voices.ps1 makes sounds/radio/<id>.mp3 and voices.json.
001: Radio check. Confirm you can hear me clearly.
004: First lap. Focus on finding your rhythm.
006: Start-finish line crossed. Lap timer is running.
016: Session restarted. Let's get back to work.
017: Qualifying restarted. Prepare for a clean lap.
029: That lap was off your best. We can recover the time.
033: That's a good one. Let's build on it.
034: Lap deleted. Reset and focus on the next one.
042: That's a substantial improvement. Excellent work.
048: Just short of your best. There is still time to find.
054: Purple sector. That's your best sector.
060: Best second sector. Keep the momentum.
067: DRS available. Use it through the marked zone.
070: DRS unavailable. Stay focused on your line.
079: Car through. Regroup and focus on the next lap.
086: You're in the slipstream. Stay tucked in and prepare to make a move.
087: Got the tow. I'll stay close.
089: You've lost the tow. Focus on your own pace.
098: Track limits exceeded. Your lap has been deleted.
099: Understood. I'll keep it within the lines.
111: Soft tyres selected. Expect strong initial grip.
112: Medium tyres selected. A balanced choice.
113: Hard tyres selected. Focus on building confidence.
121: Soft compound selected. Make the most of the grip.
122: Medium compound selected. Aim for a consistent balance.
123: Hard compound selected. Smooth inputs will help.
124: Tyre wear is high. Be gentle on the exits.
125: Tyres are cold. Build temperature progressively.
126: Tyres are coming into the window.
133: Pit box exit confirmed. Build your pace safely.
138: Everything is ready. Leave the box when you're comfortable.
141: Pit lane entry. Keep it controlled.
142: Pit lane exit. Build speed safely.
153: Damage is critical. Take care with the car.
154: The car took a hit. Checking the handling.
156: Contact with the wall. Check the car and rejoin safely.
157: Small contact. Stay focused and check the handling.
167: Car position restored. Continue when ready.
171: Time trial started. Focus on a clean lap.
172: Ghost enabled. Use it as a reference.
175: You're in the top five. Great job.
179: Time trial restarted. Make this lap count.
183: New time on the board. Excellent work.
191: Qualifying has started. You have one lap to deliver.
193: Classification is ready. Check your result.
197: Your timed lap begins now. Focus on every sector.
206: Final classification is available. Check your result.
208: That's the session done. Thanks for the support.
213: That's a podium finish. Brilliant work.
218: Check the classification for the recorded penalty.
224: Spin detected. Recover safely and check your surroundings.
225: You're facing the right way. Build speed progressively.
236: Car ahead is within reach. Keep applying pressure.
244: You're side by side. Leave room.
250: We've dropped places. Reset and focus on a clean lap.
272: Display closed. Focus on the circuit.
294: Final sector. Keep it tidy to the line.
326: Safety Car deployed. Follow the procedure and keep your speed controlled.
327: Virtual Safety Car. Maintain the required delta.
328: Safety Car ending. Prepare for the restart.
333: Blue flag. Be aware of the approaching car and follow the rules.
334: Yellow flag. Lift off and be prepared for danger.
340: Brakes are running hot. Give them a chance to recover.
q_limits: Track limits, or a touch of the wall, and the lap is gone.
q_deleted: Lap time deleted. We start from the back.
q_noworries: No worries, we go forward in the race.
q_pole: Pole position! Pole position! Mega lap!
q_goodgrid: Good grid slot. Let's get ready for the race.
q_forward: We go forward in the race.
g_clutch: Hold W and M, the clutch. Release M when the lights go out.
lap_drs: You're within a second. DRS is available.
lap_defend: Car behind is within a second. Defend.
stop_S: Good stop! You're on the softs.
stop_M: Good stop! You're on the mediums.
stop_H: Good stop! You're on the hards.
tl_2: Track limits warning. That's two. Careful on the exits.
tl_bw: Black and white flag. One more and it's a penalty.
tl_pen: Five second time penalty for track limits.
tl_push: We need to build a gap. Keep pushing.
chequer: Chequered flag is out. Next time across the line, that's it.
dmg_wing: Front wing damage. We've lost some downforce.
dmg_change: We'll change the wing at the stop.
infr_sc: You overtook under the safety car.
infr_give: Give the position back, or it's a penalty.
infr_pen: Five second penalty. We didn't give the position back.
dy_pen: Five second penalty. Not slowing enough for the double yellow.
dy: Double yellow, double yellow! Slow right down, be ready to stop.
yel_ahead: Yellow flag ahead. Slow down, no overtaking.
ret_ok: Are you okay? Stop the car, we're retiring it.
ret_thanks: As long as you're okay. Thanks for the effort.
vsc_car: There's a car stopped beside the track.
pit_cheap: A stop is cheap now. If you want it, box this lap.
vsc_end: VSC ending. Get ready for green.
sc_clear: There's been an incident. They're clearing the track.
sc_temps: Keep the temperature in the tyres and brakes.
waved: You're being waved by. Pass the safety car and join the back of the queue.
unlap: Lapped cars may overtake. Pass the leader and the safety car to unlap yourself.
limit2h: Two hour limit reached. This is the final lap.
pos_lead: P1! You're leading the race! Now build the gap.
pos_pit: Warm the tyres up and we go again.
d_pole: Yes! Get in there! Thank you, guys!
d_win: Yes! Yes! Thank you, guys! What a race!
d_contact: We had contact! Check the car.
